interpretation: G1 restores the monotone fraction ordering f2>f3>f4 in all three frozen CMB channels and reproduces the full-reference f3 and f4 response norms at the per-mille level, so it genuinely removes the isolated f3 spike rather than merely changing its denominator by a tiny perturbation. However, G1 alone leaves the f2 response 12.6x-17.2x larger than full cl_ref.pre. Therefore G1 is individually sufficient under the preregistered excursion criterion but is not a complete surrogate for the full reference-precision profile. The remaining f2 magnitude difference is descriptive context only and may reflect another precision group or inter-group interaction; it does not authorize post-hoc tuning or change the frozen G1 classification.
